meta.name: APPtivity
meta.notes: Single branded light experience (forest/sand). No multi-theme matrix in product settings.

positioning.oneLiner: Turn real interests into repeatable, high-quality group activities.
positioning.differentiator: Discover → Plan → Act → Reflect — not just another calendar.

objectionsAndAnswers.objection: We already use GroupMe and Google Calendar.
objectionsAndAnswers.answer: Those schedule; APPtivity improves the activity itself across repeats.

features.name: DPAR dashboard
features.why: Discover → Plan → Act → Reflect is the product spine for better group activities.
features.howToUse: Open Dashboard and move through Discover, Plan, Act, Reflect.
features.marketingHook: Activities that improve every time you run them.

features.name: Discover
features.why: Interests and local heat turn vague “we should hang out” into signal.
features.howToUse: Use Discover to like interests and explore local resources.
features.marketingHook: Find what the group actually wants to do.

features.name: Plan
features.why: Modules and roles make plans executable, not just calendar blocks.
features.howToUse: Build the activity in Plan with clear ownership.
features.marketingHook: Plans with roles — not hope and a group text.

features.name: Act
features.why: Execution view keeps guides and members aligned in the moment.
features.howToUse: Run the activity from Act with live roles.
features.marketingHook: Showtime with a checklist, not chaos.

features.name: Reflect
features.why: Reflection compounds quality across repeats — the anti-calendar insight.
features.howToUse: Capture what worked after each activity.
features.marketingHook: Leave the night better than you found it.

features.name: Sherpa AI
features.why: Assists planning without replacing steward judgment.
features.howToUse: Open Sherpa AI for planning help.
features.marketingHook: A guide for the plan — still your group’s call.

features.name: Join with code
features.howToUse: Enter a join code from Join with code.

features.name: Inbox & chat
features.why: Coordination stays inside the activity system.
features.howToUse: Use inbox/chat from the dashboard chrome.

features.name: Role-based participation
features.why: Stewards, guides, and spectators need different permissions.
features.howToUse: Assign roles when inviting or managing the group.
features.marketingHook: Everyone knows their job on the trail.

features.name: Local resources
features.why: ZIP-aware venues/events ground Discover in place.
features.marketingHook: What is near you — not generic internet ideas.

features.name: Activity flyer
features.why: Shareable flyers help invite beyond the app.
features.marketingHook: Invite with a poster, not a wall of text.

features.name: Onboarding trail
features.why: Founders and joiners land in the right role context.
features.howToUse: Complete onboarding screens into a group.

features.name: Settings
features.why: Profile and prefs keep the group identity coherent.
features.marketingHook: Your place in the group, clearly set.

features.name: Beta portal
features.why: Early groups need a controlled on-ramp.

features.name: Forest brand experience
features.why: Distinct emerald/sand identity signals calm, outdoor-ready community energy.
features.howToUse: Use the default light branded UI (single color experience).
features.marketingHook: Looks like a trailhead — not another SaaS dashboard.
